source_evidence: The Securities Investor Protection Corporation (SIPC) may protect you if a brokerage firm goes bankrupt or if your securities are stolen. ... SIPC does not protect you against declines in your investment holdings.
answer: SIPC may provide protection if a brokerage firm goes bankrupt or your securities are stolen. That protection does not cover declines in the value of your investments. Check whether your brokerage firm has SIPC coverage, and do not confuse it with protection against investment losses.
